scores.notes: Alice by the mushroom (left) and standing arms-folded in court (right): both a young girl of about the same age with long light golden-brown hair and fair skin.
Floating cat beside Alice (left) and cat on the branch (right): both grey striped tabbies with a wide toothy grin, pale muzzle and green-yellow eyes.
Alice holding the bottle in the corridor (left) and in the arm-chair at tea (right): same long wavy light-brown hair, fair skin, oval face and similar age.
Alice in the arm-chair (left) and drinking from the bottle in the hall (right): both a girl of similar age with long light-brown/auburn hair and fair skin.
Alice glaring in the arm-chair (left) and the small Alice before the caterpillar (right): same long light golden-brown hair, fair skin and child build.
Both show a daylit grass lawn bounded by tall clipped hedges with flower borders and trees beyond; compatible croquet-ground layout seen from different angles.
The Hatter at the tea table (left, top hat, right of the Hare) and in the courtroom (right, centre): both a gaunt, clean-shaven, middle-aged man with messy brown hair under a battered top hat.
